chunks: And it was narrated from ʿUmar ibn Yazīd that he said:
I complained to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about forgetfulness in the Maghrib prayer.
“Pray it with ‘Qul huwa Allāhu aḥad’ and ‘Qul yā ayyuhā al-kāfirūn.’”
So I did that, and it went away from me.

key_terms.السَّهْوَ: forgetfulness or lapse occurring in prayer
key_terms.فَذَهَبَ عَنِّي: it departed from me; the forgetfulness ceased
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ, recited in the prayer
key_terms.قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ: Sūrat al-Kāfirūn, recited in the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in Maghrib prayer to help with forgetfulness?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that ʿUmar ibn Yazīd complained of forgetfulness during the Maghrib prayer to Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام. The Imam عليه السلام instructed him to perform it with the recitation of Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ and Sūrat al-Kāfirūn, and he reports that this removed his forgetfulness.
